entities.name: J. Mallorquí
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Mallorquí y Figuerola was a prolific Spanish writer under over 30 pseudonyms of hundreds of novellas by various popular genres. As J. Mallorquí he is internationally known for his 192 books' series El Coyote. Several of his works have been adapted for cinema.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Mallorquí y Figuerola was a prolific Spanish writer under over 30 pseudonyms of hundreds of novellas by various popular genres. As J. Mallorquí he is internationally known for his 192 books' series El Coyote. Several of his works have been adapted for cinema.
